text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. Another task is object detection, which finds and locates multiple objects in one image. These technologies have many practical applications in daily life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to see the road, recognize traffic signs, and detect pedestrians. Doctors also use it to study medical images. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more useful in many industries.
